source.title: BUYPASS Platform Petroleum Industry Processing Specifications

lessons.scope: Document purpose; not universal card or network eligibility
lessons.statement: Use the Petroleum specification as a separately versioned source for fleet card processing on BUYPASS.

evidence.quote: This document provides information about fleet card processing with the BUYPASS

lessons.statement: AFP controller context includes card type, intended purchase or authorization amount, and whether the request is customer-activated.

evidence.quote: The following information is determined at the controller of the AFP system:
Intended purchase amount or authorization amount
Indication whether payment request is from a customer-activated device

lessons.scope: Offline AFP controller receipts, section 2.2; not online approval numbering
lessons.statement: For the described offline mode, controller-generated receipt numbers start at LA0001 and increment by one per transaction.

evidence.quote: If transactions go into off-line mode, the numbers for controller-generated receipts must start with LA0001 and be incremented by 1 for each transaction.

lessons.scope: AFP resubmission, section 2.2; do not generalize across unrelated retries
lessons.statement: A transaction declined by BUYPASS cannot be resubmitted under the described AFP configuration requirements.

evidence.quote: A transaction that has been declined by BUYPASS cannot be resubmitted.

lessons.scope: AFP debit completion retry, section 2.3.1; requires lifecycle and independent clock evidence before execution
lessons.statement: If an AFP debit completion receives no response, resend on the next connection attempt or within 15 minutes after the transaction, whichever occurs first.

evidence.quote: In the event that the device sends a debit card completion to BUYPASS and does not receive a response, the device must resend the request on the next connection attempt or within 15 minutes after the transaction took place, whichever occurs first.

lessons.scope: POS purchase/capture inside-purchase activity, section 3.2; not all completion flows
lessons.statement: An inside purchase is one activity supported by POS Purchase/Capture and is not dependent on another transaction.

evidence.quote: A POS Purchase/Capture transaction originates at a POS device.
This activity is not dependent upon any other transaction.

lessons.scope: POS and CAT time-out reversals, sections 3.7 and 3.8
lessons.statement: Resolve time-out reversal rules through the applicable current ATL105 or ISO 8583 message-format specification, rather than inventing a Petroleum timeout threshold.

evidence.quote: Please refer to the current version of the appropriate message format specifications for rules and definitions for POS time-out reversal processing.
Please refer to the current version of the appropriate message format specifications for rules and definitions for CAT time-out reversal processing.

lessons.scope: Fleet card receipt PAN printing, section 4.4.1; journal access/security requires separate review
lessons.statement: Printed receipt PANs retain only the last four digits, with X masking of preceding digits to the original account-number width.

evidence.quote: In cases where the PAN is printed on transaction receipts, it must be truncated to its last four digits.
A series of X's equal to the number of truncated digits precedes these four digits for a field length equal to the original Account Number's length.

lessons.scope: Fleet One product data, section 5.1.10; amount interpretation remains review-gated
lessons.statement: Fleet One requires product data in fleet transactions and reconciliation of the sum of product amounts to the total transaction amount.

evidence.quote: The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions.
The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.

lessons.scope: MasterCard fleet, section 7.1.5; do not apply fleet eligibility to all Mastercard credit purchases
lessons.statement: MasterCard fleet processing requires expiration validation and suppression on the cardholder receipt; authorization transmission must still include an expiry value for expired cards.

evidence.quote: The device must perform an expiration date validation on all MasterCard fleet card transactions.
The MasterCard fleet card expiration date is suppressed on the cardholder
For all authorizations, merchants must send a value even for expired cards.

lessons.scope: MasterCard fleet, section 7.1.6; issuer acceptance and live BIN eligibility are not asserted
lessons.statement: MasterCard fleet uses a Mod 10 check-digit evaluation on the full account number.

evidence.quote: For MasterCard fleet cards, a Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation is performed on the full Account Number.

lessons.scope: Visa fleet, section 8.1.5; distinguish issuer eligibility from expiration transmission
lessons.statement: For Visa fleet authorizations, expired cards still require an expiration value to be sent.

evidence.quote: For all authorizations, merchants must send a value even for expired cards.

lessons.scope: Voyager fleet product data, section 9.1.10; not automatic eligibility for other card programs
lessons.statement: Voyager requires product data in fleet transactions and the sum of product amounts must equal the total transaction amount.

evidence.quote: The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions.
The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.

openQuestions.question: Reconcile Petroleum 2025-1 by card program and flow against ATL105 2026-3 and 2026-4; which source controls any conflicting rule?
Confirm monetary components, units, precision, rounding, taxes and discounts before implementing product-total reconciliation.
Derive approved card-specific BR/TS/TC/TD chains and independent oracles; preserve generic Mastercard credit versus fleet applicability.
Review extracted tables, track layouts and diagrams against the original PDF; text extraction is not layout certification.
Resolve the Introduction's Voyager section-10 references against the version's chapter-9 bookmarks before using section identities as rule anchors.
